description: Add a song or album as a button with its cover art. Pass one Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer or YouTube link: stomp.to reads the title, artist and cover, and finds the same release on Spotify, Apple Music and Deezer when the names match. Visitors tap it and pick their streaming app. Add other services (YouTube Music, TIDAL, Amazon Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp…) afterwards with update_block links. For music that isn't out yet, pass releaseAt with title and artist (and kind) instead of a link: the button counts down, fans can ask for one reminder email, and on release day stomp.to finds it on Spotify, Apple Music and Deezer and emails them. A pre-save link and cover art can be added with update_block (links, imageUrl).

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

kind.description: Upcoming releases: a song (track) or an album. Default track.

releaseAt.description: When it comes out (the countdown ends and reminder emails go out within the hour), ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

spotlight.description: Put it in the spotlight: shown first on the page, highlighted. Only one block has it; this takes it from any other.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

title.description: Upcoming releases: the song or album title.

url.description: A Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer or YouTube link to a song or album. Leave it out for a release that isn't out yet.

name: add_music
title: Add a music button
